plan.change: Integrate the approved four lighting periods into five outdoor Staging town maps
expectedChanges: Load existing renderer and town adapter at world drawing entry points. Use morning/noon/evening/night from one in-memory state. URL and console select a period or off.

Five outdoor grounds and regular props/actor receive ambient lighting. Place station, four lamp instances and four shop masks against actual source art. Render contact/cast/pools in separate ground pass before sorted actors and overlays.
Bound caching by memory and entry count, retaining original/fallback draw paths. Additional focused regression coverage for composition, cache lifecycle and failure.

Use fixed preview noon on Staging, explicit URL/global override and immediate off. Apply geometry to source canvas and same world transform as sprite. Interior and special effects retain existing display.
